name: SafeRide (Node + PostgreSQL/PostGIS)
postCreateCommand: npm install && until pg_isready -h localhost -U postgres 2>/dev/null || node -e "require('net').connect(5432,'localhost').on('connect',()=>process.exit(0)).on('error',()=>process.exit(1))"; do sleep 1; done && npm run setup
postAttachCommand: echo 'Run: npm start   (then open the Ports tab, port 3000)'
